name: teamhatde-auto
description: Multi-profile Playwright browser system with anti-detect, session persistence and per-profile proxy

scripts.setup: npm install && npx camoufox-js fetch && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test src/*.test.ts src/flows/*.test.ts src/work/*.test.ts src/server/*.test.ts
